entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: Wise Elder Dragon spawned by the Ur-Dragon, first to name himself, who ruled humans as Dragonlord and later became de facto ruler of Dominaria.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Progenitor who spawned the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon and brother of Arcades, whose whispers drew Arcades into the war; later became a planeswalker.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Elder Dragon, brother of Arcades and Bolas.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker whose appearance interrupted the battle between Arcades and Bolas.

entities.name: Kristina
entities.description: Killed an Elder Dragon, said to be Arcades, in her duel with Leshrac.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Dueled Kristina and summoned an Elder Dragon.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War among the Elder Dragons in which Arcades joined Bolas's opponents.

entities.name: Birth of the Elder Dragons
entities.description: Event when the Ur-Dragon spawned the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent where Arcades's army fought Bolas.

events.summary: Arcades goes to investigate human structures, takes up residence in a ring fort as worshiped Dragonlord and teaches them a better way of life.
events.quote: He took up residence in a ring fort, where the humans worshiped him as their "Dragonlord".

events.summary: Listening to Bolas's whispers, Arcades throws his might into the Elder Dragon War.
events.quote: Arcades Sabboth threw his might into the Elder Dragon War

events.summary: Arcades's army fights Bolas on Jamuraa until Ugin appears; Arcades uses the distraction to retreat.
events.quote: their battle was interrupted by Ugin 's appearance

events.summary: With Bolas gone after igniting his spark, Arcades takes over the land and welcomes Bolas's abandoned armies, becoming de facto ruler of Dominaria; Bolas turns his regime into a police state.
events.quote: He became the de facto ruler of Dominaria until his death

events.summary: Arcades is killed by Kristina in her duel with Leshrac in 2834 AR.
events.quote: He was killed by Kristina , in her duel with Leshrac in 2834 AR .

relations.note: Killed him in her duel with Leshrac.
relations.quote: He was killed by Kristina , in her duel with Leshrac in 2834 AR .
along with his brothers Nicol Bolas and Chromium Rhuell

relations.note: Fought him in the war's closing stages.
relations.quote: Arcades' declining army fought against Bolas on the continent of Jamuraa
